svg.text: E2 = Patient information (name, contact, dental concern)
E13 = Daily appointment list / schedule board
E20 = Daily schedule and patient list
S12 = Past logbook entries for report
Rounded box = process or external entity; open-ended box = data store (Dn).
Wires carry the data-flow code; the legend gives the full flow name.
Where several sources feed one destination, the same code is repeated on each wire.
